payload.text: {"summary":"Validated the curated GeckoTerminal Aomi app per the aomi-app-ux-tool-maker skill; the tool layer in apps/geckoterminal was already fully curated, so this run performed the validation pass rather than a rewrite. Findings: (1) tool.rs ships 11 user-centric tools (list_networks, get_trending_pools, get_top_pools, get_new_pools, search_pools, get_pool, get_pool_ohlcv, get_pool_trades, get_token composite, get_token_price batch, check_token_safety) wrapping 17 of the spec's 20 operations; the 3 unwrapped ops (/tokens/multi, /pools/{addr}/info, /tokens/info_recently_updated) are justified prunes covered by other tools or serving no user story. (2) PREAMBLE in lib.rs reconciles exactly with the shipped tools — all 11 have capability lines, conventions match exposed args, and workflow guidance matches the composite behavior. (3) cargo build is clean (cdylib produced). (4) Live API smoke passed: GET /networks and GET /networks/base/trending_pools?include=base_token,quote_token,dex both return correct JSON:API payloads (20 pools, 28 hydrated includes), confirming BASE_URL and include-hydration are correct. (5) test.json already seeds the highest-value user_story ('Show me the trending pools on Base right now, then deep-dive the top one...') and was preserved per skill policy. No edits were required; nothing outside apps/geckoterminal was touched (the app is app-local mode — client lives in apps/geckoterminal/src/client/, no ext/ files needed).","changedFiles":"","followUps":"Run /aomi-app-e2e-tester geckoterminal to expand test.json into the full multi-turn TDD spec and run the e2e harness. Optionally smoke-chat via aomi-run apps/geckoterminal/target/debug/libgeckoterminal.dylib. Note the public API is rate-limited (~10 calls/min), so the e2e run should space its calls."}
